$comment: DTM 2013 car images drawn by Pappydhorn12 (used with the artist's permission). Each source file is a square sheet of a team's cars on black, stacked top to bottom; 'cars' lists their numbers in that order and 'team' (or 'teams') picks the team image (the lower-numbered car, as the game shows one car per team). tools/car_drawings.py crops them; tools/car_art.py leaves these teams alone. The other car of each team is kept in art/liveries (not in the pack) for a future livery choice (wishlist E4); 'liveries' names the team of a 'teams' sheet's other cars. Checked against the 2013 spotter guide on 2026-11-07.

edits.note: #23's name panel read 'T. Schneider': drop the n (Timo Scheider)

BMW_Team_Schnitzer.png.note: the first file named Schnitzer holds the 2013 RBM cars (Farfus #7 Castrol EDGE, Hand #8 Exide on the M3), which match the spotter guide

BMW_Team_Schnitzer_1_2.png.note: the corrected Schnitzer file (Spengler #1 BMW Bank, Werner #2 Adrenalin in Serie), saved under this name next to the first one

Mucke_Motorsport.png.note: #18 Wehrlein is drawn in the one-off VfB Stuttgart design, as on the spotter guide

not_used.BMW_Team_RBM.png: Farfus #7 in BMW Bank colours and Hand #8 on the BMW M4 body: the 2014 cars. In 2013 BMW Bank was Spengler's #1 (Schnitzer) on the M3.
